text:
Alex M.: quick heads-up — we’re shifting next week’s release window to a shorter, weekday-only cadence because of a planned infra maintenance in eu-west-3. short plan below, pls ack if you have active rollouts.
Maria G.: noted. which days/hours?
Alex M.: maintenance: Tue 04/06 02:00-08:00 UTC (network patch). release window moved to Mon 04/05 16:00-22:00 UTC and Wed 04/07 12:00-18:00 UTC.
Jen L.: can we get a hard freeze for DB migrations during that window? migrations + maintenance = nope.
Sourabh P.: +1 — require freeze for any schema changes that touch serving or routing. migrations need opt-in by eng-releases with rollback plan.
Alex M.: yes — effective immediately: no schema migrations touching serving or routing during Mon/Tue/Wed window unless approved by eng-releases. Exceptions must include rollback steps and owner contact.
Maria G.: adding a simple checklist for approval: owner, migration script, rollback, smoke tests, canary plan, expected duration. posting below.
Maria G.: ```
Approval checklist v1:
- Owner handle + pager
- Migration script + idempotency notes
- Rollback SQL/plan
- 10% canary + verification queries
- Expected downtime (if any)
- Estimated runtime
```
deploy-bot: scheduled_maintenance: eu-west-3 network patch on 2026-04-06T02:00:00Z -> 2026-04-06T08:00:00Z. All non-critical infra ops will be paused during this window.
oncall-team: please publish the oncall rota for Tue night — we need one infra lead + one runtime lead.
Alex M.: also adding a temporary rollback threshold tweak: any rollout exceeding 2.5% error uplift over baseline for 10m must be automatically paused and paged to oncall. Ops will run a forced rollback if no action in 8m.
Jen L.: documenting that in rollout runbook now. can we get config snippet for auto-pause?
Sourabh P.: paste config snippet: ```json
{"auto_pause": true, "error_uplift_threshold": 2.5, "window_mins": 10, "escalation_mins": 8}
```
Maria G.: thanks — we’ll surface this in the console release notes and add an annotation requirement: every release PR must include `release.owner` and `release.escalation_contact`.
Alex M.: final ask: if you have any active canaries or long-running experiments, comment on this thread by EOD. we’ll compile and communicate explicit green/yellow/red guidance by 18:00 UTC tomorrow. :loud_sound: 
Jen L.: ACK. I have a canary running against embeddings model — will post status.
Sourabh P.: ACK. rolling out an infra-side kernel patch on Mon morning; not a schema migration but will need small traffic shift.
Alex M.: thanks all. will follow up with a short summary doc and a pinned note in #eng-notices.
